scopeReview: CED CHA-2.B.2–4 and CHA-2.C.1: derivative function, notation, equivalent limit forms and tangent-line slopes/equations. Derivatives are derived from limits; power/product/chain rules are not assessed before their topics. Domain restrictions are explicit.
varietyReview: Definition selection, identifying a base input, cubic point derivative, point-slope construction, derivative versus coordinate ratio, two derivative functions, unequal one-sided quotient limits, equivalent notation, tangent intercept and horizontal tangent height.
repetitionReview: Each prompt and all four options were read separately; distinct tasks/contexts within this set. Cross-topic exact duplicates checked by validator. Semantic similarity and AP difficulty remain judgment calls, not proven by an automated score.

questions.independentReasoning: Check numerator and denominator roles separately: f(x+h)−f(x) is the output change and h is exactly (x+h)−x. For the constant function f=1 the omitted-subtraction expression fails, while any fixed-h quotient in a nonlinear function can differ from the limit. Only the full definition supplies all parts.

This is an average rate for a finite input change, not the defining limiting rate.
